title: Imbalanced
description: If this creature's attacks are fully blocked by any player, it becomes [gold]Stunned[/gold].
smart_description: If [gold]the creature's[/gold] attacks are fully blocked, it becomes [gold]Stunned[/gold].
notes: Triggers when this creature deals damage that is fully blocked. The creature then becomes Stunned on its next turn. Special case: If the owner is a BowlbugRock monster, it sets IsOffBalance instead of becoming Stunned.
